# AIActKit 2026 — EU AI Act Art. 50 Transparency Guard

> Zero-dependency GitHub Action, Node.js 20/22+ CLI, and 100 % client-side EU AI Act Risk Classifier, Article 50 Banner Generator, and CSV/JSON AI Register — aligned with Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Art. 50 in force since 2 August 2026) and Digital Omnibus Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.

## Free Tools & GitHub Marketplace

- [Browser-Side EU AI Act Risk Classifier, Art. 50 Banner Builder & AI Register](https://yannabadie.github.io/ai-act-art50-guard/): Interactive FR/EN compliance tool with zero data upload.
- [GitHub Marketplace Action (`yannabadie/ai-act-art50-guard@v1.0.0`)](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/aiactkit-eu-ai-act-art-50-transparency-guard): Detects 36 AI/LLM SDKs, synthetic media tools, chat widgets, and Art. 50 disclosure markers in repositories.
- [XML Sitemap](https://yannabadie.github.io/ai-act-art50-guard/sitemap.xml)
